description:
Adds a drawing to the specified page.

**Note:**
This method can be a little bit slow, because it runs the document calculation
process to arrange tables on the specified page.

params.description: A drawing to add to the page.
params.name: oDrawing

params.description: The X coordinate in English measure units.
params.name: x

params.description: The Y coordinate in English measure units.
params.name: y

signature: AddDrawingToPage(oDrawing: ApiDrawing, nPage: number, x: EMU, y: EMU): boolean
